en: The postcard is a black-and-white photograph showing a military complex with a large, rectangular building on the right, a long lower building with large windows in the center-left, and trees lining the property. In the background, a church steeple rises above the rooftops, suggesting a European city setting. There is handwritten red numbering ('27072') on the top right and a caption in white at the bottom left.
